top_verse_en: Then the devil took Him to the holy city and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple.

refs.t_en: Then the devil led Him to Jerusalem and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple. "If You are the Son of God, " he said, "throw Yourself down from here.
Jesus answered, "You would have no authority over Me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed Me over to you is guilty of greater sin."
After Jesus' resurrection, when they had come out of the tombs, they entered the holy city and appeared to many people.

Now the leaders of the people settled in Jerusalem, and the rest of the people cast lots to bring one out of ten to live in the holy city of Jerusalem, while the remaining nine were to dwell in their own cities.
who indeed call yourselves after the Holy City and lean on the God of Israel--the LORD of Hosts is His name.
Awaken, awaken, clothe yourself with strength, O Zion! Put on your garments of splendor, O Jerusalem, Holy City! For the uncircumcised and unclean will not again enter you.

O Lord, in keeping with all Your righteous acts, I pray that Your anger and wrath may turn away from Your city Jerusalem, Your holy hill; for because of our sins and the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and Your people are a reproach to all around us.
But exclude the courtyard outside the temple. Do not measure it, because it has been given over to the nations, and they will trample the holy city for 42 months.
The portico at the front, extending across the width of the temple, was twenty cubits long and twenty cubits high. He overlaid the inside with pure gold.
